Trust me."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"From up in the trees I can see who still hasn’t voted."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Pink cathedral with a quiet courtyard, best seen from the side gate when the light hits the glass."},{"poi_id":"p26","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Coconut coffee upstairs, slow sips and a good view of the street below."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Climb the stone steps early, peek into the cave shrines, and let the marble carvers’ chisels be your soundtrack."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Stand under the tall Lady Buddha and let the sea wind sort out your thoughts."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Weave through the aisles, point at whatever smells best, and let the market ladies feed you like family."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p27","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Egg coffee with a view of the dragon's back — creamy, sweet, and the sky does the rest."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"The dragon breathes fire over the river, and every bridge lights up like it's showing off."}]}
